fieldValues.title: A decision record is one standing choice
fieldValues.decision_question: What qualifies as a decision record?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's walk of 2026-10-11 after session srs-programme#100; awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: A decision record is one standing choice that governs future choices, stated so that it reads true later and says when it is reviewed; tasks, applications, plans and bundles are recorded elsewhere and linked to it.
fieldValues.rationale: A log of tasks and applications hides the few choices that govern the rest, and the owner cannot judge a flood of mixed records.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a record accepted under this rule proves to be a task, an application or a bundle, or when a standing choice cannot be recorded under it.
